about: Golden cases for the So-what v2 composer (spec/so-what-v2-design.md). Each case: inputs (fixture path, or embedded rows for the diversity-run stories), the fixed seed, the numbers the rules read, and the expected headline, line 2, hook family, hook, body, register and anchor. if_true and significance_rows are test inputs standing in for the new backend fields (linear and region-proxy estimates, marked). Embedded rows are trimmed to the rows a composer reads at that focus (world, audiences, countries with share >= 0.5%, the entry and focus country and their regions); the full responses give the same outputs. picks lists every seeded choice as index of candidates, so a composer can be checked slot by slot.
seed_rule: seed = djb2(story text) as a decimal string unless the caller passes one; slot pick = candidates[djb2(seed + "|" + slot) mod len(candidates)]
